title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: six-class (negation + GLV) parallel Pollard rho in G1, global work meter, truncated-product canonicalisation, 131/134-instruction step listing charged, 148-instruction object, faithful interpreter, derived allowance rows

claims.statement: For a uniform challenge T=[x]P0 in BLS12-381 G1 (T=infinity returns 0), the algorithm in proof.md outputs x with success probability at least 0.39, and on every run its total work is at most 2^126.2433 batched-incomplete-affine-G1-addition equivalents (one unit = C = 2,000 scalar AArch64 instructions, the organizer's fixed 6M normalization: 3M for the addition formula plus 3M for Montgomery batch amortisation, 6 x 383 = 2,298 rounded down to 2,000; the constant is fixed and this submission changes none), enforced by a global work meter that charges every action at an upper-bound price before execution and halts with failure at 2^126.2433. The algorithm is parallel distinguished-point Pollard rho (2^20 walks, distinguished probability 2^-64, trail cap 20*2^64) on the (r-1)/6 classes of G1 under negation and phi(x,y)=(beta*x,y)=[lambda], lambda=0xac45a4010001a40200000000ffffffff; class key |y|; canonical twist index decided exactly from a truncated 12-multiply fixed-point product of x by floor(2^448*beta/p) with an exact one-multiplication fallback on near-ties (a separately metered action; proof.md section 1.1); R=2^20 twisted table so each step is one batched affine addition plus at most 134 instructions on the 1-in-64 step that executes the refresh's two stp and constant store and 131 instructions otherwise, the ledger's sixteen traffic classes (proof.md section 5.1) assigning every instruction of the complete batched-addition dataflow exactly once: the six multiplications per element (3M formula: lambda, lambda^2, y_3; 3M Montgomery batch inversion: N-1 prefix mults, 2(N-1) recovered-inverse mults, one Fermat inversion 232,864/N) are inside the fixed reference price, while the record interface, the walk rows, the batch-product zero-denominator test (row 10 loads and tests the transferred batch accumulator Pi = prod z_i from the batch's stationary frame slot, not a key limb), the meter charge, the inversion share the 6M rounding does not reach, and the forward prefix pass's control and entry-address fetch (4 instructions, row 13: pointer advance, entry fetch, counter, branch) are charged in R; cycles of F of length <=64 detected by a period-64 checkpoint alone and escaped by doubling the cycle's minimum class under one fixed total order (192-bit key fingerprints, used for the checkpoint test and the traversal minimum) (a class map; no cancellation can close a cycle through doublings since the order of 2 mod r is 2^250.86), so trails meeting a common class reunite (merging lemma); fresh uniform trail coefficients stored in full; collisions solved by re-walking with coefficients reduced mod r and x=(e_2-e_1)/(f_1-f_2) mod r verified before output. Phase 1 stops when a hard operation counter reaches S_ops=1.015*S0 (S0=sqrt(2N'ln(1/0.6097)), ordinary steps priced 1.0655234375 units and the 1-in-64 refresh step 1.067, cycle-traversal steps 1.0745 and doublings 1.5195 (the 134-instruction refresh-step listing), 1.0655234375*(S_ops+2^60)<2^126.241548, N'=((r-1)/6)*R/(R-1)); phase 2 completes open trails; report capacity 2^63.25 and 8 processed matches are caps counted as failure. Peak memory below 2^72 bytes; preprocessing (all work before the first walk step: jump table, report-table initialisation, first 2^20 trail starts) at most 2^57.2 units, enforced by a meter sub-cap and included in the total; no advice. Heuristic H1: within S_ops class arrivals of all trails (all arrivals counted, including fruitless-cycle repeats and trail starts) the first inter-trail collision has occurred with probability at least 1-exp(-(S_ops/1.015)^2/(2N'))=0.3903 (random-mapping law with a 1.5% slowdown allowance; toy slowdowns scale with mean trail length/sqrt(N), extrapolating to +0.24% +- 0.18% at production trail ratios); the meter's early-halt probability (expected doubling and traversal surcharges against the headroom, Markov) is below 0.000062 (below 0.00019 if those rates are tripled), the |y| bits used for partition and distinguished tests are pseudo-random, and, apart from the detected and escaped fruitless cycles of F of length <=64 (whose repeated arrivals are counted in the collision budget), a trail returns to a class it visited earlier at most with the random-mapping self-collision probability L_max^2/(2N) per trail; the canonical twist index of a new class is uniform on the 6 units and independent of its partition index, and beta*x mod p is equidistributed along the walk (these affect the 2-cycle/doubling rate and the section-1.1 fallback rate, hence only the early-halt probability of the meter, below 0.000062); supported by toy-curve experiments (including a no-automorphism control and a scaled full-pipeline mode); no production-size run. The step listing is object-verified and text-synced to the shipped object (span_asm.py, span-disasm.txt, text_sync.py; every structural claim machine-extracted, all rows Y): 132 literal machine instructions per element iteration (126 leaf, 6 prefix), 134 charged (131 non-refresh, 3 refresh-only), 20 instructions in the row-6 record/entry interface and batch-product transfer, 5 exit stubs with in-degree 1,1,1,1,3, zero identity mismatches. The link is saved once per batch by `sub sp,sp,#16` / `stur x30,[sp,#8]` (16-byte frame, stationary address) and restored by `ldur x30,[sp,#8]` at all six sites. The product slot is `[sp,#0]`: row 6 stores the priced reference addition's Montgomery prefix accumulator (x8) there, row 10 loads it back for the `cbz` zero-denominator test; the span contains no instruction that computes the product (it is produced inside the priced 6M reference addition, class 2, charged in H), and the C-boundary marker is a comment, not an instruction. 6 eligible same-record store/reload pairs, maximum distance 56 against the bound of 134; 10 cross-record candidates excluded from fusion credit, each still charged. Dynamic evidence (dynamic_trace.py, dynamic-trace.txt) is a transfer and ordering trace: 1,000/1,000 commits with the value at the `cbz` equal to the slot contents, to the row-6 store and to the C-boundary accumulator; 0 unattributed x8 writes between store and test (re-injection flagged, control C9); 8,000/8,000 elements with every record field read before the first record write (control C8 detected 8/8); 1,000/1,000 link restores with the exit stubs executed (controls C3/C4); plus a no-injection smoke run in which x8 is never assigned and the predicate still sees exactly what the emitted store and load carried. The listing is also complete, not merely matched row by row: completeness.py enumerates the object from the emitter (schedule.build() rows in emit_asm() order, then the instructions emit_asm() appends itself) and asserts the assembled object holds exactly 149 instructions, 1:1 and in order — 132 literal rows (2 prologue, 4 prefix, 126 leaf) plus 17 lines that belong to no row (the return ending the prefix pass, the return ending the leaf body, five exit stubs of three) — with __text = 0x254 bytes ending at the last instruction and zero unattributed instructions; the charge is 131 = 129 non-refresh machine instructions + 2 amortised per-batch rows (meter, Fermat share) and 134 = 132 + 2, and the 17 scaffolding instructions cost 6.5e-5 per element against the 0.1115 per element the Fermat-share row over-charges, so the charged listing covers every instruction of the object (three planted enumeration defects each detected). The two underived allowances 2^74.8 and 2^95.3 and the 1.1e-7 reserve are deleted from the cost chain: their contributions were below 2^-21 of the terms they entered, so every printed value is unchanged (log2_U1 126.241548, headroom 116.55, meter 0.000059, success 0.39024).

experiments.purpose: Part A: on BLS12-381 G1, check the GLV pair, orbit size 6 and unit action, |y| class key, canonical member, the section-1.1 truncated-product canonical index against the exact rule (random and adversarial near-tie inputs), twisted-step identity, doubling class map, the multiplicative order of 2 mod r, table entries, coefficient tracking, and recovery of a planted x from two production trails forced to merge. Part B: run the per-trail algorithm of proof.md on a toy curve y^2=x^3+4 over F_q and report the joint success rate of the scaled production pipeline (phase-1 budget, phase 2, report cap, 8-match cap) at n=3000, with the cost chain, its six derived allowance rows and its five success-side failure terms.
